incident_window: [first positive label, first positive label+6), truncated at observed stay end; early initial-positive patients excluded from incident endpoint
policy: first threshold crossing once per patient; repeated-alert comparison; early alert can consume the only review
consent: simulated independent patient opt-out of labs/vitals; scheduled revocation at hour 12; all derived state cleared and feature replayed under permissions
training: A train only; validation for hyperparameters and candidate thresholds; calibration disjoint; B calibration separate from frozen B test
training_rows: Only rows before inferred onset (first positive label+6); all observed rows for benchmark-negative patients
utility: Official challenge utility on full-stay hourly states; once-policy uses latched state after first alarm. This is distinct from review count.
